Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.33 of 2022, under Section 498A, 304B, 323 IPC & Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Delhupur, District Pratapgarh.

3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the sister of the informant was married to the applicant and was blessed with two children, however, the applicant used to harass her for dowry and on 13.09.2022, information was received that the sister had died.

The postmortem report on record indicates that there was no external injury seen all over the body and the cause of death could not be Ravi Alias Ravi Chandra vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

1 ascertained.
Subsequently, on the analysis of the viscera report, aluminum phosphide was found which apparently is the cause of death also.

4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
5.

On perusal of the material on record, prima-facie, there is nothing to suggest that the applicant as the husband, had subjected the victim to any physical or mental harassment in relation to demand of dowry soon before her death, as such, the applicant who has no criminal history and is in custody since 23.01.2023 is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Ravi alias Ravi Chandra be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 16.4.2024 nishant  Ravi Alias Ravi Chandra vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
